documents.title: Reply To Clarification On Significant Increase In The Volume Of Security Across Exchanges In Recent Past Sought By BSE Limited
Clarification sought from DMCC Speciality Chemicals Ltd
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Reply To Clarification On Significant Increase In The Volume Of Security Across Exchanges In Recent Past Sought By NSE Limited.

analysis.summary: DMCC Speciality Chemicals reported its Q4 and FY26 financial performance, highlighting a significant top-line increase driven by raw material price inflation that was successfully passed on to customers. The company faced severe supply chain disruptions and availability issues regarding sulfur due to the Middle East crisis and Gulf of Hormuz transit challenges, as well as boron ore supply issues from Turkey in the first half of the year. Consequently, working capital requirements expanded substantially, leading to higher short-term borrowings. Management noted that while regional demand in Europe remains challenged and certain end-use industries like ceramics faced energy-related gas crises, the company is actively developing alternative markets such as Latin America and Asia. Management reported a flat top line of INR 126 crores for Q2 FY26, which was higher by 25% year-on-year, while profit before tax stood at INR 8.28 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for non-boric products in end-use applications like ceramics and glass was impacted by a gas crisis affecting consumers in Morbi and other places.
demand_outlook.quote: So, in terms of the non-boric products, which are things like ceramics, glass, all that, they depend a lot on energy in the form of gas. So, CNG or natural gas is the main source of fuel, the most economical source of fuel, which became a bit of a crisis and continues to be a bit of a crisis in all the consuming centers, like Morbi and other places where they are making the frits.

demand_outlook.claim: European markets continue to struggle, leading to a reduction in the company's speciality chemical business in Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: And other parts of the business, Europe continues to struggle. So, our speciality chemical business has reduced in Europe, but it is improving in other parts of the world.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is selling products into China, Japan, and developing new markets in Latin America.
demand_outlook.quote: We are selling some product into China, a little bit in Japan and also developing new markets in Latin America.

demand_outlook.claim: The company successfully replaced most of the European business with business in Latin America.
demand_outlook.quote: We have been able to replace most of the European business with business in Latin America.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that consumption in Europe has come down and a lot of plants are shutting down.
demand_outlook.quote: On the positive side, and that is not because of competition or anything, but it's more because the consumption in Europe has come down.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the overall situation has been better than the previous two years, with the major exception of the European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: And overall, the situation has been better than the previous 2 years with one major exception being the European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that European consumption of materials has come down, leading to a loss of export sales mostly in Specialty Chemicals.
demand_outlook.quote: So we have lost some of our exports to Europe as well, not to competition, but basically the consumption of those materials in Europe has come down.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed positive changes in domestic consumption in India, particularly in the boron business where they experienced good growth.
demand_outlook.quote: So apart from positive changes in the domestic consumption in India and particularly in the boron business where we have had some good growth, the export sales and that constitutes mostly Specialty Chemicals has taken a hit because of the EU market conditions.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that they are making some headway in Latin American countries with decent growth and are also selling some products into China.
demand_outlook.quote: And we are looking at and we have been active in developing new markets. So we are making some headway in Latin American countries, where we have seen decent growth. And we are also selling some products into China, which we were not doing earlier.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a solar power plant at the end of the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also commissioned at the end of the quarter a solar power plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Approved capital expenditure for the year is about INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: About INR 10 crores is our CAPEX approved for this year and it will be around the same level next year unless we do some other projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that all major investments planned have been made and they are not envisaging any major capex at this time.
capex_expansion.quote: And all our major investments that we had planned have been made. So we are not envisaging any major CAPEX at this time.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has a plan of about INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores for capex.
capex_expansion.quote: We have a plan of about INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores, but nothing major compared to what we have done, the major expansion at Dahej, which happened over the last few years.

margins_costs.claim: Incremental working capital lines carry an interest rate in the range of 8.75% to 9%.
margins_costs.quote: So, it's about 9%, 8.75% to 9% in that range is the percentage of interest.

margins_costs.claim: Sulfur costs have increased for all consumers and producers of sulfur-based sulfuric acid.
margins_costs.quote: Sulfur costs have gone up, not only for us, but for all consumers of sulfur and producers of sulfur-based sulfuric acid.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on price increases resulting from higher sulfur costs to customers.
margins_costs.quote: So, far, we have been able to pass on the price increase to the customers.

margins_costs.claim: For the full year, the company reported EBITDA margins of about 13.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the full year, we've had EBITDA margins of about 13.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that an unusual jump in the sulfur price occurred, which will get reflected in contract pricing in Q1 of the financial year.
margins_costs.quote: What happened in the previous quarter is an unusual jump in the sulfur price, which will get reflected in the contract pricing in Q1 of this financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: The Roha plant was slowed down to about 60% capacity for roughly 15 days to manage raw material availability.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the Roha plant essentially was affected in the month of March only. So, we didn't shut down the plant as such, but we slowed down the plant to about 60% capacity and just to ensure that we didn't need to shut down. It took us a while to organize sufficient raw material.

orders_capacity.claim: The commodity business operating on sulfuric acid and allied products operates at between 95% to 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our commodity business, which is sulfuric acid and allied products that operates at more than 90% capacity, I would say, between 95% to 100% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The specialty chemical business operates at or slightly below 50% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: The specialty chemical business is at or maybe slightly below 50%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated they have not come close to achieving full capacity utilization in their plants as yet.
orders_capacity.quote: We have not come close to achieving full capacity utilization in our plants as yet, but we've made progress over the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that capacity utilization in the Specialty Chemicals business is between 50% to 60% on average.
orders_capacity.quote: I would say we are between 50% to 60% in our Specialty Chemicals business in terms of capacity utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that in bulk chemicals, the company is practically running at full capacity of 90% or 95%.
orders_capacity.quote: So in the bulk chemicals, we are practically running at full capacity. So even last year, we would have run at 90% or 95% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has reduced its debt as reflected in the balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: We have reduced our debt, as you can probably see from the balance sheet, and we will continue to do so.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the working capital position is quite comfortable.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital position is quite comfortable.

risks_headwinds.claim: About 50% of global sulfur trade flows through the Gulf of Hormuz, causing availability and price issues due to the Middle East crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: Most of the sulfur traded flows through the Gulf of Hormuz. In fact, about 50% of global sulfur trade is through Hormuz. So that has affected availability and therefore the price of the product not only in India but also in other parts of the world including China.

risks_headwinds.claim: In the first half of the financial year 25-26, production was lost due to supply disruptions of boron ore from the main supplier in Turkey.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first half of the year, we lost a lot of production because of disruption in supply of the boron ore from our main supplier in Turkey.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulfur prices have been rising dramatically prior to the war due to demand from a new nickel smelter in Indonesia pulling away about 3 million tons of sulfur.
risks_headwinds.quote: Prior to that also, the availability of sulfur was short compared to the demand. So, if you look at the last couple of years, the sulfur price has just been rising dramatically. Nothing to do with the war by itself initially but more because demand particularly from a new nickel smelter in Indonesia which requires sulfuric acid and therefore sulfur which pulled away something like 3 million tons of sulfur disturbing the market even before the war started.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Maharashtra government has not transferred the land parcel near Ambernath back to the company's name despite a Supreme Court verdict in favor of the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Maharashtra government has still not transferred the land back to our name in spite of the court order. So, we are not able to monetize it as yet.

risks_headwinds.claim: Boron business shipments were delayed because the new distributor lacked experience, setup, and stock in India.
risks_headwinds.quote: Basically, the new distributor did not have any setup or any experience in the business.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports to Europe declined due to internal issues within Europe including their energy policy.
risks_headwinds.quote: The other reason, and this is also clearly mentioned in our presentation is that exports, particularly to Europe have come down.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that one of the potential threats to profitability is the upcoming commissioning of a large copper smelter in Kutch later in the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: One of the potential threats to our profitability, as mentioned in the report, is the upcoming commissioning of a large copper smelter in Kutch, and that is expected to happen sometime later this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the copper smelter is expected to put some downward pressure on the sulfuric acid market with a trickle-down effect all over the country.
risks_headwinds.quote: But that is expected to put some downward pressure on the sulfuric acid market and while it may mainly affect Northern Gujarat and things like this, so we do expect a trickle-down effect all over the country

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start commercial sales for a specialty product used in polymers for enhanced oil recovery.
management_commitments.quote: So currently we have started some commercial sales. But, again, I can't give you any projection of how much it's going to be, etc.

management_commitments.claim: The management has plans to increase R&D intensity in the coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: But we do have some plans for increasing this, and you will see that in the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects normal operations in the boron business starting from the second half of the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: And we look forward to the boron business recovering from the second half of the current quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that products recently launched will get fully accepted in the current year and new products will be developed for commercialization next year.
management_commitments.quote: And we expect that the products which we've recently launched will get fully accepted in this current year. And in this current year, we will develop some new products, which we'll take up in the next year for commercialization.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to transition to the new tax regime by next year or the year after.
management_commitments.quote: So both plants are in the same company, and we are currently under the old tax regime, but we expect by next year, we'll go to the new tax regime next year or the year after.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
